note: A FORWARD erratum. The V0S evidence is untouched; the corrected claims are recorded here and in the H0 verdicts.

host observation separated from session binding

correctedClaims.v0sClaim: one endpoint in the attempt's canonical event-id set is sufficient to admit a Work relation
correctedClaims.correction: per-relation ROLE semantics: the correct endpoint must be the requested Attempt AND the evidence's own compared field must name it; a shared node cannot satisfy two attempts

correctedClaims.v0sClaim: requiring the evidence carrier to be one of the attempt's own events is the safe rule
correctedClaims.correction: that rule EXCLUDED two genuine relations, because T0 carries a promotion on PROMOTION_COMMITTED and a governed reopening on TASK_READY — different entity types. The requirement is on the ROLE, not the carrier's entity type

correctedClaims.v0sClaim: a claimed SessionId may be READ and then not admitted
correctedClaims.correction: a claimed SessionId triggers ZERO reads; the claim is a declaration, the admission is NOT_REQUESTED, and READ_FAILED/SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE are reserved for an attempted read

correctedClaims.v0sClaim: the reader's sourceIdentity identifies the adapter
correctedClaims.correction: it identified the adapter AND leaked an absolute local installation path into a consumer-visible successful page; the identity is now a logical label with the path retained only internally

correctedClaims.v0sClaim: a matching attemptId with a non-null HostJobId is a LOCAL_PORT_OBSERVATION
correctedClaims.correction: a caller-supplied record is a CALLER_DECLARATION; LOCAL_PORT_OBSERVATION requires a producer-established origin

correctedClaims.v0sClaim: an attributed session read is sufficient for COMPLETE
correctedClaims.correction: COMPLETE additionally requires FULL event-page coverage; a partial page is PARTIAL and says so

correctedClaims.v0sClaim: an exit flag plus a termination flag means the exit was LATER observed
correctedClaims.correction: both facts are reported and the ordering is stated as NOT established

correctedClaims.v0sClaim: a FOREIGN_ATTEMPT distinction may be made by scanning all projects
correctedClaims.correction: the ordinary Attempt Preview is project-scoped; the unscoped probe is removed

correctedClaims.v0sClaim: a failed T0 projection is reported as an unavailable optional owner
correctedClaims.correction: a TrajectoryRefusal names a CANONICAL WORK SOURCE integrity failure
